decoration: minimal — one or two subtle shapes
hero_layout: split — portrait/visual on one side, text on the other
hero_headline_scale: large — noticeably big, makes a statement
hero_cta_style: floating action buttons with hover effects
nav_style: bottom bar — fixed navigation at the bottom
card_style: terminal window styled cards (title bar with dots)
scroll_animation: playful — elements slide/bounce in from different directions
hover_effects: moderate — scale, shadow change, color transitions
contact_style: playful — with a friendly CTA headline
border_radius: mixed — sharp sections with rounded cards
spacing_density: ultra-spacious — luxury feel, huge gaps between sections
color_scheme: light mode with dark hero section
quirk: hero text must be extremely large, almost full viewport width
